{"diagnosis": "recv_buf_data sampled 0xd2 instead of expected 0xa5 (0xa5>>1|0x80), indicating a one-half-bit late shift with stop-bit captured. State 0 detects !ser_rx and clears recv_divcnt, but state 1 then waits for recv_divcnt > cfg_divider (full bit) before entering state 2. That full-bit start wait misaligns all default-state recv_pattern sampling to bit edges instead of bit centers.", "patch_diff": "diff --git a/picosoc/simpleuart.v b/picosoc/simpleuart.v
--- a/picosoc/simpleuart.v
+++ b/picosoc/simpleuart.v
@@ -83,6 +83,6 @@
 				1: begin
-					if (recv_divcnt > cfg_divider) begin
+					if (recv_divcnt > (cfg_divider >> 1)) begin
 						recv_state <= 2;
 						recv_divcnt <= 0;
 					end
 				end
", "expected": "tohost PASS (no FAIL 0xdead/TRAP), loopback send 0xa5 got 0xa5 with new checksum != 7ead7d9c1ebd862283bf0991c6a01fd4f7dad63f24f2be953b7f57e1f7edd073"}
